prompt: This code has a compile error. Why?
choices: Car cannot extend Vehicle because speed is private
Car() must explicitly call super(speed) since Vehicle has no no-arg constructor
Constructors are not inherited, so Car() cannot exist
speed must be protected, not private
explanation: Vehicle only defines a one-arg constructor. Java inserts super() into Car() if no super call is explicit, but there is no no-arg Vehicle(). Fix: Car(int speed) { super(speed); }
